_doc: Reputation and the title ceremony (GDD 4.12.1, 4.12.2, ap. A; docs/contratos/h9_titulos.md); H10: the government, elections, taxes and price regulation (GDD 4.12.3, 4.12.4; docs/contratos/h10_cargos.md) [balance]. The offices themselves: data/offices/.

reputation._doc: classes: the social classes of the class modifier (family.class_reputation, GDD 4.12.1: reputation with a class = reputation + class_reputation[class]). class_share: a change with a class also moves that class's modifier by round(amount x class_share). reason_class: the class of the changes other systems make (Reputation.change reasons). log_size: changes kept in family.reputation_log. rules: what the events of a step give (Reputation.step): events (event types), amount (global), class ("target" = the other one's class: the counter's customer or the townsperson; an id; null), class_amount, cap / cap_days (at most cap times per window of cap_days days; 0 = no cap), min_quality (sales), action and ok (npc_action). passive: per_business_with_staff, at dawn, for each operative workshop of the family with an active employee (ap. A).

ceremony._doc: GDD 4.12.2: the request is made in person at the town hall (the map's town_hall service tile); the gold is paid and the requirements checked; the first holder of approvers (an office of H10) approves if its affinity with the actor is >= min_affinity; a vacant office (no holder: all of them until H10) approves by itself.

government._doc: GDD 4.12.3, procedural government (Offices.setup, once per game): the household families (AI without profile, by id) take household_titles[i] (common past the list); then each office, from the top of the chart, gets for each seat the adult of a household whose family title is exactly its min_title (oldest first, then id; at most 1 office per person) unless it is in start_vacant (GDD: 1-2 minor offices left free) or nobody fits (vacant). take_reputation: reputation when someone takes an office, by office rank (GDD 4.12.1 'ocupar un cargo') [provisional].

elections._doc: GDD 4.12.4, ap. A. levels: the campaign level chosen when running (gold, ledger politics; bonus in per mille). vote: score = affinity x relation/relation_norm + reputation x reputation/reputation_norm + class x class modifier/class_norm + campaign x campaign permil/campaign_norm, each term clamped to -1..1; a voter never votes a candidate whose family it feels an 'against' emotion for, and prefers one it feels a 'favor' emotion for (a bribe secures the vote). actions: visit (relation with each adult of the visited family, busy_hours without another campaign action), bribe (gold, secured vote; check stealth vs the voter's empathy, a failure costs scandal reputation), speech (check rhetoric vs target_value; success: bonus_permil with the voters within range_tiles; once a day), defame (check stealth vs target_value + modifier; success: the target candidate loses penalty_permil; failure: scandal reputation; once a day). keep: closed elections kept.

taxes._doc: GDD 4.12.3: with a tax collector in office, every family pays tax_percent (the collector sets it, min-max; default_percent when it takes office) of its sales of the day before (categories) at dawn, ledger taxes; the collector's commission (its passive) comes out of what is collected.

regulation._doc: GDD 4.12.3, the market inspector: regulate_price moves the market price of one item (buy and sell) by +-percent for days days; fine_merchant takes fine_gold from a family with a business (ledger fines) [provisional].
